Page 185 Cont. Harry J. Alyea - 46 -
Jan. 31
Page 186
Jan. 31 E'd Perkins - 27 -only support of widowd mother - drinks ....
Jan. 31 Theresa Agnes Haire - 3 - beautiful little Child unable to situp or stand. Enrolled To-day.
1940, February
Feb. 7th Mrs. Anna Quell - 50 - blind now for eight years - recently takes weak spells.
Arthur Schmide - 47 - lutheran - drinks - mother asks for prayers. Frank Florek - 47 - fearfully painful legs - in feet at times - desperate.
Margaret Walsh - 50 - Stroke & pneumonia.
Mrs. Dwson - Gall stone
E'd Nugent - 45 - nerveous - has wife and 4 small children - pro- mises to get another "City of God" - started - tempted to drink.
Forum Exercismis - -
Page 187 Feb. 7 Thanks - Ward Larkin - 39 - Maidstone, Ont. - was hopeless with hemoraging - unconscious for 3-4 days - was Enrolled - week before Xmas - is here To-day thanking God.
James Lordon - 4 - muscular paralysis, has never been able to sit up. Enrolled again To-day Wm O'Connor - 80 - gall-stone trou.
9 Mr. & Mrs. Martin - 31 - had accident Dec. 15st last and lost sight in right eye. Drs. say nothing can be done-though she can distinguish light from dark is Enrolled To-night - 1.00
